implementation_summary: Added balancedSelector() (brackets, parentheses, quotes) so rules with unbalanced selectors are dropped. FRAME_CSS is now emitted in its own <style> after the AI style element. The meta CSP hashes both style elements; the header CSP already hashed every style element via styleHashes. Existing single-style test assertions now cover all served style elements; new regression tests added.

risks: Served preview HTML now holds two <style> elements. Any consumer that assumed a single one (stored previews are re-rendered, but exported files or other tests) should use styleHashes/previewCspForHtml.
